J2d all off-diagonal components vanish (.detail: so vacuum <=> Q = 0 and (r^2 Q)' = 0 <=> Q = 0

J4c uniform ball: v = H r, Q = 3H^2 = 8.detail: inside a uniform dust ball the river is a contracting Friedmann universe
